screens.title: Today: the count of what needs the person in the title, one card with who asks, the feature and the answer, Later, the queue of the next things, Working now with the spend of today, the reminder to log time, the panels of the role, My work, Since you were away; the Ask bar in the top bar
Today, light theme
Design: the diagram or picture fits the zoom frame at the first paint; a sideways gesture or a drag pans it, a pinch zooms it, Fit brings it back
Specs
Plan

Flow: each feature once in five stages (Idea, Spec, Build, Review, Ready), the views Flow, List, Done and Health, the filter All, Needs me and Mine, and New feature; a card shows the title, who works on it and its state
Factory / Agents map: a node shows the ticket key and title, the step name or the file name; the ref is the tooltip and Copy ref is in the node menu; a run node opens the run page

Code / Pull requests: a full-width list with a search, the filter All and Needs review, and the groups Open, Merged and Closed; each row shows the number, the title, the draft, checks and review state, and no author
Knowledge: tabs with icons; the manual opens from the account menu, F1 or the palette, not from a tab
Top bar: sidebar toggle, Back and Forward, Sync with ahead and behind, Activity, search, Files and Terminal buttons, Ask split button, notifications, account menu
Projects: Clone and Open
Menu bar panel: spend, runs with Stop, Needs you, agents switch, sync, project, Open Shipyard
Knowledge / Slides: HTML deck in a sandboxed frame, Present, Export PDF; Markdown deck read only with Convert
Assistant: message box, then one bar with attach, the model and effort menu, the permission, the context ring and Send
Settings / Connections: each MCP server has an allow list picker (All tools, Read only, Custom with one checkbox for each tool)
Onboarding tour: six steps with a title, one sentence and a picture; opens once after the first project; Close, Back, Next, Done and Open the manual
Settings / Me, Permissions: each OS permission with its state and one action; the Get started checklist; the section list
Settings / Project: a section list that stays in view, with an icon per section, above panels with an icon in each heading
Settings / Me: the Theme select (Light, Dark, OLED, System, System with OLED, imported themes), Theme files with Import and Export, a row for each imported theme with Remove, and the preview dialog
Factory / Workflows: the list shows each name with its step names; Duplicate, Rename and Delete are in the More actions menu; the id shows in the editor header

Settings / Me: the Language select (English, French, German, Spanish, imported languages), Language files with Import language and Export English, the Mark untranslated text switch when a language file is current, a row for each imported language with Remove, and the import dialog
New project: the five steps of the creator, the preview of the files and the start choice
Work / Team: the members and the rights of each role and member, by area
Flow / Feature: the page of one feature from a run, with the stage line, the one action of the state, one question for its approvals, and the sections Story, Brief, Design, Changes, Checks and Chat
Flow / Done: each ended feature, newest end first, with search; a row opens the feature page
Factory / Usage: the success rate, the Budgets panel with Edit, and the runs with their key and title
Today / Activity: the live runs with Stop and the sessions with Stop, as a view of Today (it replaces the Activity panel of the top bar)
Account menu: Settings / Me, Theme (Light, Dark, System), Manual, Shortcuts, What's new, Replay the tour
No project: one page for every space with Open a folder, Clone a repository and New project
First run: the role step with Continue, then the open-a-project step

Flow / Feature, Changes: the pull request of a feature with the header, the four tabs, the merge box and the conversation; the old pull request address opens it. the header with the state, the branches and the line counts, the four tabs, the merge box with Checks, Comments and Approvals and a Merge split button, the description, the conversation with threads, and the sidebar with reviewers, links and Cited by

Code / Pull request, Files changed: the file tree with a filter, Expand all, the viewed count, collapsed file rows with their counts, a thread and a pending comment under a line, and the pending review bar with Submit review and Discard
Code / Pull request, Submit review: the verdicts Comment, Approve and Request changes, the review text with Preview, and the list of pending comments
Shell: the place menu with Today, Flow, Plan, Crew, Library and Code, Setup at its foot, and one section switch at the top of the page
Today / News: the notifications by day with the action of each one, Mark all as read and Clear; the only list of notifications
Ask bar, open: the answer that names each blocked feature with its action, Go to with places and search results, Do with the actions and the prompts of the page, Open the full assistant
Flow / List: the features as rows with the same filter, the old Backlog and Changes addresses
Flow / New: what to build, the kind, three ways (an agent writes the spec, I write the spec, build now), and start from a ticket
